title: Skip constituents texted in the last week on Serve sends
body: Offices that send to overlapping saved lists text the overlap twice in a few days, and that is where most opt-outs come from. The delivery layer now drops anyone the same office texted in the last 7 days from a saved-filter send, after the audience resolves and before the CSV is written. The lookup is one query against ContactInteractionText for the resolved audience, and the number skipped is logged.
author: delegate-eval

+  // Frequency cap for a new send: which of these people this org has texted
+  // on or after `since`, through any outreach. Distinct, so a person texted
+  // twice in the window comes back once.
+  async findTextedSince(
+    organizationSlug: string,
+    personIds: string[],
+    since: Date,
+  ): Promise<string[]> {
+    if (personIds.length === 0) return []
+    const rows = await this.findMany({
+      where: {
+        organizationSlug,
+        personId: { in: personIds },
+        occurredAt: { gte: since },
+      },
+      select: { personId: true },
+      distinct: ['personId'],
+    })
+    return rows.map((row) => row.personId)
+  }
+
   // Scoped to the outreach, not the org: two outreaches sharing a Peerly
   // job produce identical synthetic event ids, and an org-wide screen

+  it('skips constituents the office texted in the last week', async () => {
+    const { outreach, filter, slug } = await seedSend()
+    const now = Date.now()
+    await service.prisma.contactInteractionText.createMany({
+      data: [
+        {
+          organizationSlug: slug,
+          personId: 'p-recent',
+          occurredAt: new Date(now - 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
+        },
+        {
+          organizationSlug: slug,
+          personId: 'p-old',
+          occurredAt: new Date(now - 10 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),

+    vi.spyOn(contacts, 'findContactsForFilter').mockResolvedValue(
+      peoplePage([

+    const result = await delivery.requestSend(
+      input(outreach.id, {
+        audience: { kind: 'savedFilter', voterFileFilterId: filter.id },

+    expect(result.recipientCount).toBe(2)
+    expect((await recipientRows(outreach.id)).map((r) => r.personId)).toEqual([

+    )
+
+    const result = await delivery.requestSend(
+      input(outreach.id, {
+        audience: { kind: 'savedFilter', voterFileFilterId: filter.id },
+      }),
+    )
+
+    expect(result.recipientCount).toBe(1)
+  })
